claims.claim: ĀML can evaluate declared interface meaning before rendering.
The public prototype can produce ALLOW and SUPPRESS decisions from declared restoration_value and attention_cost inputs.
A fixed AML execution can reproduce the same receipt.
Browser evidence can detect mutation of bound receipt and evidence fields.
The same AML witness contract is exercised through Python and Go reference verifiers using a black-box conformance harness.
ĀML publishes an immutable verifier contract snapshot and checks for silent drift.
ĀML publishes a numbered machine-readable publication library.
ĀML could become a broadly used interface accountability layer for AI-generated interfaces.

non_claims: reference implementations counted as independent external witnesses
